title: TRIZ principle 1 — segmentation
problem_statement: A monolithic object is hard to handle, repair, or adapt. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Divide an object into independent parts: sectional furniture, modular phones, microservices. Segmentation trades one big problem for many small manageable ones.
novelty_assessment: One of the most-used TRIZ principles; modularity as a deliberate invention move. Novelty check: search prior art for each claimed transfer before investing.
validation_plan: List 3 products improved by segmentation in your field
Prototype a segmented variant; measure repair time
